arStrings.szText: {icon:bullet,1.2} When {c_important}Blood Hunt{/c} exceeds {c_number}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} seconds, you explode in a {c_important}Feral Rage{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds, allowing all of your {c_important}Werewolf{/c} Skills to dash you towards your target and dealing {c_number}[Affix_Value_2*100|x%|]{/c} bonus damage. Killing enemies extends the duration of {c_important}Feral Rage{/c} by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} second.
